Exam Enchanter

Plan your study time around your exams. Add your subjects, then click the calendar to add study sessions, study windows, breaks or other activities, and drag them to fit.

Add to the calendar

Choose what to add above, then click an empty slot. Drag a block to move it, or drag its bottom edge to change its length. With the keyboard: arrow keys move a selected block, Shift and the arrows change its length, Delete removes it.

Exam dates come from the Curro Durbanville November 2026 timetable. Check them against your own, and note that venues can change. Your plan is saved on this device only.
